channel.title: Arbata: Blog
channel.description: Articles about quitting coffee, caffeine and switching to tea, with sources.

item.title: Is Decaf Coffee Caffeine-Free?
item.description: Decaf coffee has little caffeine, but not none: figures from a study (0–13.9 mg per 473 ml), the EU rule and who should care about the leftovers.

item.title: Tea During Pregnancy: A Guide to Your Daily Cup
item.description: Which tea is okay during pregnancy: the caffeine limit (up to 200 mg a day), black, green, matcha, decaf and herbal teas.

item.title: Caffeine and Sleep: What the Research Shows
item.description: How much caffeine shortens sleep and delays falling asleep: numbers from two meta-analyses (22 and 24 studies), the role of dose and timing, and the limits of the research.

item.title: Coffee or Tea in the Morning? The Great Morning Debate
item.description: Coffee or tea in the morning: which has more caffeine, whether coffee gives more energy, what a caffeine crash is and which teas to try instead.

item.title: How to Quit Coffee: Breaking Up With Caffeine Without the Drama
item.description: How to quit coffee without the headache: cut caffeine gradually, swap cups for tea, and know what to expect in the first few days.

item.title: How Long Does Caffeine Withdrawal Last and When Will You Finally Feel Better?
item.description: How long caffeine withdrawal lasts: symptoms, a day-by-day timeline (onset 12–24 hours, peak 20–51 hours, 2–9 days) and ways to ease it.
